description: Returns departure times for a specific WSF ferry route on a given date. Requires numeric terminal IDs — use wsdot_get_ferry_terminals to resolve terminal names to IDs; terminalPairs on wsdot_get_ferry_routes lists the pairs with service on a date. Set remainingOnly to true to show only future departures for today (useful for "next ferry" queries). For future dates, all sailings for that day are returned. Each sailing carries its vessel ID, WSF's loading-rule code, and the pair's annotations that apply to it — notes such as "No interisland vehicles" that decide whether a sailing takes a car. Sailing times are ISO 8601 UTC while tripDate is the Pacific service day, so evening sailings carry the next UTC date — convert to America/Los_Angeles before quoting a clock time. Cancellations are not carried here — WSF drops a cancelled sailing from the schedule instead of flagging it, so a listed sailing is not confirmation that it will run. Check wsdot_get_ferry_alerts for disruptions; those are scoped to a route, not an individual sailing.

arrivingTerminalId.description: Numeric ID of the arriving terminal.

departingTerminalId.description: Numeric ID of the departing terminal. Use wsdot_get_ferry_terminals to look up terminal IDs.

remainingOnly.description: When true, returns only future sailings for today. Ignored for future dates. Default: false.

tripDate.description: Date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if omitted.

name: wsdot_get_ferry_schedule

annotations.description: Notes WSF attaches to this pair's sailings (vehicle restrictions, routing, delays), converted from HTML to plain text with link destinations kept as "text (url)". Sailings point at the ones that apply to them through annotationIndexes. Empty when the pair has none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSF Ferry API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `invalid_access_code`: WSF rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. `invalid_terminal_pair`: The terminal ID pair is invalid or does not form a valid ferry route. `invalid_date`: The tripDate is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date, WSF rejects it as outside the dates it has published a schedule for, or WSF lists no routes on it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Optional notice when no sailings are found — e.g. invalid terminal pair or no service for this date. Absent when sailings are present.

remainingOnly.description: Whether the result holds only today's remaining sailings. False for any date other than today, whatever was requested.

sailingNotes.description: A note covering every sailing on this pair (e.g. a boarding-pass requirement), converted from HTML to plain text. Absent when WSF publishes none, which is the case for most pairs.

sailings.description: Scheduled sailings for this route and date.

items.description: One scheduled sailing with departure time, vessel assignment, and the notes that apply to it.

annotationIndexes.description: Positions in annotations of the notes that apply to this sailing; each resolves to an entry. Empty when none apply.

arrivalTime.description: Scheduled arrival time (ISO 8601, UTC), on the same terms as departureTime. Absent on the routes WSF publishes no arrival time for.

departureTime.description: Scheduled departure time (ISO 8601, UTC). WSF publishes schedules in Pacific time, so a sailing late in the service day carries the following UTC calendar date and will not match tripDate. Convert to America/Los_Angeles before showing a clock time.

loadingRule.description: WSF's loading-rule code for this sailing. WSF does not document the codes: 3 appears on nearly every sailing, and 1 has appeared only on sailings whose annotation restricts vehicles. Read the sailing’s annotations for the restriction itself.

vesselHandicapAccessible.description: Whether WSF marks the assigned vessel as handicap accessible.

vesselId.description: ID of the assigned vessel — the same vesselId wsdot_get_vessel_locations reports.

title: Get Ferry Schedule
